title: Intrinsic Bias Metrics Do Not Correlate with Application Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing intrinsic bias metrics (WEAT and XWEAT, which measure cosine similarity between gendered words and attribute concepts in embeddings) with extrinsic bias metrics (performance gaps like Predictive Parity and Equality of Opportunity) in downstream coreference resolution and hate speech detection tasks, after artificially debiasing and overbiasing the embeddings.

Measuring intrinsic bias using a newly created Spanish XWEAT test (comparing European-Spanish vs. Migrant-Spanish names against pleasant and unpleasant terms) and comparing it against extrinsic performance disparities (precision and recall gaps) in a Spanish hate speech detection downstream task.
